packet.description_seed: India's government said three Indian sailors were missing and 21 crew had been rescued after the hit on the Settebello off the coast of Oman.

what: Three Indian sailors missing after US says it hit tanker in Gulf of Oman

clean_source_blocks.text: The US military has disabled an oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman that it accused of violating an American blockade by "attempting to transport oil from Iran". In a post on X, US Central Command said an aircraft fired "precision munitions" into the engine room of the Palau-flagged Settebello "after the crew repeatedly failed to comply with directions from American forces". India's government said three Indian sailors were missing and 21 Indian crew members had been rescued after the attack on the Settebello off the coast of Oman. It said the "targeting of commercial shipping and civilian infrastructure in the region must end". The US military blocked access to Iran's ports after Tehran effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, through which some 20% of the world's oil and gas supplies are transported, during the ongoing conflict.
India's government said three Indian sailors were missing and 21 crew had been rescued after the hit on the Settebello off the coast of Oman.

India on Wednesday lodged a formal diplomatic protest with the United States after a missile attack on a commercial oil tanker off the coast of Oman left three Indian sailors missing and raised fresh concerns over the security of international shipping routes in the Gulf. In a significant diplomatic move, Nagaraj Naidu, Additional Secretary in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), summoned Jason Meeks, the United States Charge d'Affaires in New Delhi, and issued a demarche over the attack. India protests attack, seeks accountability The development came hours after New Delhi strongly condemned the strike on the Palau-flagged oil tanker Settebello, which was carrying 28 crew members, including 24 Indian nationals. The vessel came under attack while sailing about 20 nautical miles northeast of Sohar, a key port city in Oman.

US forces have disabled eight vessels and redirected 134 others since initiating the blockade on 13 April, according to Centcom. Following the latest incident, the Indian government summoned the deputy head of the US mission in Delhi, officials told the BBC. Earlier this week, US forces hit another Palau-flagged oil tanker with an Indian crew. The Marivex was also fired on in the Gulf of Oman after it failed to comply with US instructions, Centcom said. All 24 crew were rescued by the Omani military, Indian authorities said. Meanwhile, tensions between Iran and the US show no sign of easing. On Wednesday President Donald Trump threatened to hit Iran "hard". Trump said Tehran was taking too long to sign a peace deal and was playing Americans "for suckers".

The war began on 28 February, after the US and Israel launched strikes on Iran that killed the country's supreme leader.

[Lähde: Crypto Briefing]
A US military jet struck a sanctioned oil tanker carrying 24 Indian crew members near Oman, escalating diplomatic tensions and raising fresh questions about energy market stability.

India called in a US diplomat to formally protest a military strike on an oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman, an incident that put 24 Indian seafarers in harm’s way and added another layer of friction to an already volatile geopolitical picture in the region.

The strike, carried out on June 8, targeted the Palau-flagged tanker MT Marivex after the vessel allegedly attempted to breach a US-enforced blockade aimed at Iranian ports. An F/A-18 Super Hornet launched from the USS Abraham Lincoln fired a precision munition at the ship’s engineering and steering areas. The tanker caught fire.

The MT Marivex was no stranger to controversy. The vessel had been previously sanctioned for its links to Iranian oil trade, and its attempted run through the blockade made it the seventh ship disabled under intensified US enforcement operations in the region.

After the strike ignited a fire onboard, the crew issued distress calls detailing both the attack and the blaze. Omani military helicopters carried out the rescue operation, pulling all 24 crew members to safety.

Indian authorities, including the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, confirmed they were coordinating with Oman on the crew’s safety. The formal summoning of a US diplomat signals that New Delhi views this as more than a routine maritime enforcement action.

This wasn’t an isolated event. The MT Marivex strike was the seventh vessel disabled under what has become a sustained US campaign to choke off Iranian oil exports through naval enforcement.

Prior US actions in May 2026 against vessels linked to Iran had already rattled energy markets. Oil prices spiked above $100 per barrel during that earlier round of confrontations.

Oman’s role as the rescue coordinator adds another dimension. The sultanate’s military conducted the rapid response to the distress calls following the June 8 strike.

For investors watching energy-sensitive assets, including crypto, the Gulf situation deserves attention. Prior US enforcement actions in May 2026 caused oil to breach $100 per barrel, and the volatility bled into broader markets including major cryptocurrencies.

In a significant diplomatic move, Nagaraj Naidu, Additional Secretary in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), summoned Jason Meeks, the United States Charge d'Affaires in New Delhi, and issued a demarche over the attack.

India protests attack, seeks accountability

The development came hours after New Delhi strongly condemned the strike on the Palau-flagged oil tanker Settebello, which was carrying 28 crew members, including 24 Indian nationals.

The vessel came under attack while sailing about 20 nautical miles northeast of Sohar, a key port city in Oman.

A missile struck the ship's engine room, triggering a fire and forcing the crew to issue a distress call.

The MEA said 21 Indian crew members had been rescued, while search operations were continuing for the remaining three sailors.

"The Indian Embassy in Muscat is closely monitoring the situation and remains in touch with Omani authorities involved in the search and rescue efforts," the ministry said.

payload.title: Kolme intialaista merimiestä kateissa Yhdysvaltain iskettyä öljytankkeriin Omaninlahdella
payload.summary: Intian mukaan kolme intialaista merimiestä on kateissa ja 21 miehistön jäsentä on pelastettu sen jälkeen, kun Yhdysvaltain joukot iskivät Palau-lipun alla kulkeneeseen Settebello-öljytankkeriin Omanin rannikon edustalla.
payload.content:
Kolme intialaista merimiestä on kateissa Omaninlahdella tehdyn iskun jälkeen, Intian hallitus kertoo. Yhdysvaltain asevoimat sanoo lamauttaneensa Palau-lipun alla kulkeneen Settebello-öljytankkerin, koska alus sen mukaan rikkoi Yhdysvaltain saartoa yrittämällä kuljettaa öljyä Iranista.

## Isku osui tankkerin konehuoneeseen

Yhdysvaltain keskisen sotilasjohdon mukaan ilma-alus ampui tarkkuusaseita Settebellon konehuoneeseen sen jälkeen, kun miehistö ei toistuvasti noudattanut amerikkalaisjoukkojen ohjeita. Intian viranomaisten mukaan 21 intialaista miehistön jäsentä on pelastettu, mutta kolme on edelleen kateissa.

Alus oli Omanin rannikon edustalla noin 20 meripeninkulmaa koilliseen Soharista, joka on merkittävä satamakaupunki. Settebellon kerrotaan kuljettaneen 28 miehistön jäsentä, joista 24 oli Intian kansalaisia.

## Intia jätti diplomaattisen vastalauseen

Intia on tuominnut iskun ja vaatinut vastuunkantoa. Intian ulkoministeriön korkea virkamies Nagaraj Naidu kutsui Yhdysvaltain asiainhoitajan Jason Meeksin New Delhissä kuultavaksi ja jätti asiasta muodollisen diplomaattisen vastalauseen. Intian hallituksen mukaan kaupalliseen merenkulkuun ja siviili-infrastruktuuriin kohdistuvien iskujen alueella on loputtava.

## Saarto lisää painetta tärkeällä merireitillä

Yhdysvallat on estänyt pääsyn Iranin satamiin sen jälkeen, kun Teheran käytännössä sulki Hormuzinsalmen. Salmen kautta kulkee noin viidennes maailman öljy- ja kaasutoimituksista, mikä on lisännyt huolta kansainvälisten merireittien turvallisuudesta Persianlahden ja Omaninlahden alueella.

Yhdysvaltain keskisen sotilasjohdon mukaan amerikkalaisjoukot ovat lamauttaneet kahdeksan alusta ja ohjanneet 134 muuta pois sen jälkeen, kun saarto aloitettiin 13. huhtikuuta. Aiemmin samalla viikolla Yhdysvaltain joukot iskivät myös toiseen Palau-lipun alla kulkeneeseen öljytankkeriin, Marivexiin, jolla oli intialainen miehistö. Senkin kerrottiin jättäneen Yhdysvaltain ohjeet noudattamatta. Intian viranomaisten mukaan Omanin armeija pelasti kaikki Marivexin 24 miehistön jäsentä.

Iranin ja Yhdysvaltojen välinen jännite ei osoita laantumisen merkkejä. Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trump uhkasi keskiviikkona iskeä Iraniin kovaa ja syytti Teherania rauhansopimuksen viivyttämisestä.
summary_bullets: Kolme intialaista merimiestä on kateissa Settebello-öljytankkeriin tehdyn iskun jälkeen.
Yhdysvallat sanoo aluksen rikkoneen Irania koskevaa saartoa ja jättäneen ohjeet noudattamatta.
Intia on tehnyt Yhdysvalloille diplomaattisen vastalauseen ja vaatinut iskujen loppumista kaupallista merenkulkua vastaan.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu paketin BBC- ja Indiablooms-lähdetietoihin. Keskeiset luvut, sijainti ja diplomaattinen reaktio on rajattu lähteissä mainittuihin tietoihin.

article.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu paketin BBC- ja Indiablooms-lähdetietoihin. Keskeiset luvut, sijainti ja diplomaattinen reaktio on rajattu lähteissä mainittuihin tietoihin.
article.source_text:
The US military has disabled an oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman that it accused of violating an American blockade by "attempting to transport oil from Iran". In a post on X, US Central Command said an aircraft fired "precision munitions" into the engine room of the Palau-flagged Settebello "after the crew repeatedly failed to comply with directions from American forces". India's government said three Indian sailors were missing and 21 Indian crew members had been rescued after the attack on the Settebello off the coast of Oman. It said the "targeting of commercial shipping and civilian infrastructure in the region must end". The US military blocked access to Iran's ports after Tehran effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, through which some 20% of the world's oil and gas supplies are transported, during the ongoing conflict.

India's government said three Indian sailors were missing and 21 crew had been rescued after the hit on the Settebello off the coast of Oman.

India on Wednesday lodged a formal diplomatic protest with the United States after a missile attack on a commercial oil tanker off the coast of Oman left three Indian sailors missing and raised fresh concerns over the security of international shipping routes in the Gulf. In a significant diplomatic move, Nagaraj Naidu, Additional Secretary in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), summoned Jason Meeks, the United States Charge d'Affaires in New Delhi, and issued a demarche over the attack. India protests attack, seeks accountability The development came hours after New Delhi strongly condemned the strike on the Palau-flagged oil tanker Settebello, which was carrying 28 crew members, including 24 Indian nationals. The vessel came under attack while sailing about 20 nautical miles northeast of Sohar, a key port city in Oman.

US forces have disabled eight vessels and redirected 134 others since initiating the blockade on 13 April, according to Centcom. Following the latest incident, the Indian government summoned the deputy head of the US mission in Delhi, officials told the BBC. Earlier this week, US forces hit another Palau-flagged oil tanker with an Indian crew. The Marivex was also fired on in the Gulf of Oman after it failed to comply with US instructions, Centcom said. All 24 crew were rescued by the Omani military, Indian authorities said. Meanwhile, tensions between Iran and the US show no sign of easing. On Wednesday President Donald Trump threatened to hit Iran "hard". Trump said Tehran was taking too long to sign a peace deal and was playing Americans "for suckers".
